text:
mari: Hey team — following the paging storm last night (PD #INC-2026-487), we need to lock in a postmortem. Customer impact: ~3% of hosted inference requests returned 503s between 02:13-02:48 UTC for customers in eu-west1. Root cause still under investigation but likely an autoscaler race + KV cache eviction mismatch.

oncall-bot: Incident ticket: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-487|INC-2026-487>. Timeline and initial logs attached in the ticket. Paging history: @sam was primary, @lee was secondary.

sam: Available for a PIR Tue/Wed next week after 15:00 UTC. Can facilitate if needed but prefer someone external to the mitigation flow.

lee: I'm out Tue afternoon but free Wed 16:00 UTC. I can present the mitigation timeline + logs we captured.

priya: Can do Tue 16:00 UTC if that works. If not, Wed is fine. I can take notes and own tracking for action items.

mari: OK sounds like Wed 16:00 UTC is the common slot. If someone else wants to facilitate, shout. Otherwise I can chair and handle the facilitator duties (agenda, pre-read, recording). I wasn't on-call but I ran the customer impact check.

alex: I can facilitate — prefer to run it as a 45m session (15m timeline, 15m root cause/actions, 15m follow-ups). Will need the pre-read 24h before.

tom: +1 for Alex facilitating. Also flag: compliance asked for an executive summary for the affected customer accounts — can someone pull the per-tenant impact table? @priya?

priya: I can pull per-tenant metrics and a lookup of affected orgs. Will share CSV by Tue EOD.

sam: Action item from mitigation: add a guard in autoscaler to prevent overlapping scale-down + KV eviction during rolling updates. I'll draft a proposal and link it in the PIR. ETA Fri COB.

lee: I'll attach the KV cache logs and the temporary mitigation steps we applied (script snippets below):
```
# temp mitigation
for pod in $(kubectl get pods -l app=kv-cache -o name); do
  kubectl cordon $pod || true
done
```

mari: Notes on attendees: @sam (primary oncall), @lee (secondary), @priya (SRE), @alex (infra lead), @tom (prod ops), mari (product), plus optional invite to security/compliance. Any add-ons?

alex: Please add @jordan from compliance and @nadia from customersuccess — they want to be briefed. I'll send calendar invite with recording enabled.

mari: OK creating the calendar invite for Wed 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC (45m). Pre-read: incident ticket, mitigation logs, per-tenant impact CSV, autoscaler proposal draft. @priya please upload the CSV to the ticket when ready.

oncall-bot: Reminder: set meeting recording on and mark PIR as private for customer data. Use: /meet create PIR-INC-2026-487

priya: Uploaded CSV to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-487?focusedCommentId=3456

mari: OK — facilitator = Alex, note-taker = Priya, owner for remediation = Sam (autoscaler guard), owner for KV cache investigation = Lee. I'll create the action items in the PIR doc with owners and dates.

sam: Quick ask: can we add a fallback policy so that when KV cache misses spike we temporarily route to a lower latency replica pool? I can prototype in a branch.

lee: That sounds reasonable — let's discuss in the PIR. I can provide the metrics threshold we observed: error rate > 0.8% for 5m triggered cascading failures.

alex: Confirming facilitation. I'll post the agenda tomorrow and send the calendar invite shortly. Thanks all.

mari: Thanks team. If anyone cannot make Wed 16:00 UTC, call it out now so we can reschedule. Otherwise I'll lock it in and ping the exec summary owner for affected customers.

tom: I can make it. I'll prep the customer-impact blurb for execs.

sam: I'll be there. 

lee: In. 

priya: In. 

alex: In. 

oncall-bot: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event?eid=pir-inc-2026-487

mari: Closing loop — postmortem scheduled and facilitators/owners assigned. Will post the pre-read link in this thread once ready. :thumbsup:
